rule: extended: modules under the isolated heavy thresholds (wall at most 10 min, peak at most 10.5 GiB; one process per module on 4 CPUs with the CI runtime) that run on push to integration and on demand, not per pull request. They are the modules whose setup refuses until the pending source-pin refresh, ranked by isolated wall at refreshed pins and taken in rank order until the per-pull-request light tier's projected mean shard wall after that refresh is within 15 min of 2026-11-12's (36.8 min) at the conservative hosted/isolated ratio 1.43. After the first hosted measurement past the refresh, ranks 19-25 return to the light tier while its measured mean stays within that budget. Rank 26 is outside that ranking and never returns by it: the effect probe's device-mode subset, which runs step_with_public eagerly (minutes per step) because its jitted CPU compile peaks far above the light bar.
